## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND and HYG/LQD signals (HYG 1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30% ABOVE TREND) show risk-tilt while reflation cues — CPER (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND — keep the cycle engaged.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear creeping in via VXX (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND (fear ↑ rising). Credit stress signal mixed with HYG (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%) CORRECTION versus LQD (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND, and stocks vs bonds flat/below trend (SPY 1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36% BELOW TREND; TLT 1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07% ABOVE TREND).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tight: UUP (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION shows a stable dollar while the yield-curve signal is steepening (Yield Curve ↑ rising) and duration demand keeps TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Defensive and energy leadership: XLU (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND, XLP (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +9.34%) ABOVE TREND, XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging with XLK (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND and Financials showing weakness (Financials breadth 1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%) — style: mixed, defensive/energy favored.

5. US vs Global?
US soft: SPY (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%) BELOW TREND while EM/EAFE pockets outperform — EEM (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +3.01%) ABOVE TREND and EWJ (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +8.40%) ABOVE TREND; China weakness persists with FXI (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation index rising; ARKK (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -7.64%) RECOVERY but IBIT (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%) BELOW TREND shows crypto risk remains depressed, and small-cap IWM (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -0.72%) BELOW TREND — selective risk-taking.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity reflation visible: CPER (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ABOVE TREND; gold in RECOVERY with GLD (1W: +3.23% | 1M: -2.19%) RECOVERY and silver volatile (SLV 1W: +10.92% | 1M: -19.52%) RECOVERY.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy showing strength: XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ABOVE TREND, while natural gas UNG (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%) BELOW TREND remains under pressure.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: multiple defensives and energy ETFs ABOVE TREND (XLU 1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15% ABOVE TREND; XLE 1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73% ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: XLI (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +7.92%) in CORRECTION and XLK (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND — sector rotation, not market-wide risk-off.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor energy and defensives showing strength (XLE 1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73% ABOVE TREND; XLU 1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15% ABOVE TREND) and monitor reflation plays (CPER 1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27% ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to tech and China risk (XLK 1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02% BELOW TREND; FXI 1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95% BELOW TREND); bonds (TLT 1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) remain a hedge.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND; Utilities XLU (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Tech XLK (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND; Financials (sector breadth 1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%) showing weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Copper/energy — CPER (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%) BELOW TREND and volatility-sensitive silver SLV (1W: +10.92% | 1M: -19.52%) RECOVERY (watch for mean reversion).

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (VXX 1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55% ABOVE TREND) as a complacency/fear pivot, HYG/LQD ~0.72 (HYG 1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30% ABOVE TREND) for credit stress, Tech/Financials ratio ~2.70 (Tech vs Financials 1W: -1.19% | 1M: -1.63% ↓ falling) as rotation trigger.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, with defensives and energy showing relative strength (XLU 1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15% ABOVE TREND; XLE 1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73% ABOVE TREND). Key risk: tech and China weakness (XLK 1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02% BELOW TREND; FXI 1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95% BELOW TREND) and elevated VXX (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) that could widen short-term dispersion.
